name: Broken or placeholder image
description: tags with empty src, missing src, or placeholder values ship as broken-image boxes. Use real images, generated assets, or remove the tag.

name: Flat type hierarchy
description: Dominant heading and body roles are separated by less than 1.25× at every step, leaving the size hierarchy flat. Add at least one stronger size step.
snippet: Role sizes: body 16px, h1 16px, h2 16px (largest adjacent step 1.00:1; target 1.25:1)
